description: This source file implements Windows-specific trust store management for certificate validation, including functions to determine trustworthiness for server authentication, manage certificate stores, and retrieve issuer certificates.

classes.name: TrustStoreWin::CertStores
classes.description: Manages multiple Windows certificate stores, including creation, initialization, and collection management for testing and production.

classes.name: TrustStoreWin::Impl
classes.description: Implements the core logic for managing certificate stores, retrieving issuers, and determining trust status for certificates.

methods.name: IsCertTrustedForServerAuth
methods.description: Determines if a certificate can be used for server authentication based on its EKU extension.

methods.name: TrustStoreWin::TrustStoreWin
methods.description: Constructor initializing the trust store management, including loading system and enterprise certificates.

methods.name: TrustStoreWin::GetTrust
methods.description: Returns the trust status of a given certificate, considering various Windows certificate stores and EKU properties.

methods.name: TrustStoreWin::SyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Retrieves issuer certificates for a given certificate from the stored certificate collections.
